facts.scope_summary: Implementation of a Silicon Customer Owned Tooling (COT) supply chain solution for Google spanning SAP S/4HANA, Kinaxis, and E2Open to provide end-to-end manufacturing visibility, traceability, planning, partner collaboration, and cost transparency. The engagement covers phased delivery across manufacturing operations, product test and quality, procurement, finance, logistics, trade compliance, integrations, and organizational change management.

out_of_scope: CO/FICO configuration owned by Google internal team
Material valuation, costing, yield accounting, TMS, EWM and Commercial Invoice APIs if handled by Corp Eng/ASCII or otherwise out of scope for Bristlecone
Manufacturing collaboration and Silicon Data Hub net new integrations are not in scope of Bristlecone
assumptions: Material valuation, costing, yield accounting, TMS, EWM and Commercial Invoice APIs are either handled by Corp Eng/ASCII or are completely out of scope for Bristlecone.
BOM explosion owned by PLM sharing GPNs/BOMs with CM partners can largely be leveraged from present instance SAP and consumed by Kinaxis.
TSMC PO capability must be live by Dec 4; 22-week fab runway bounds upstream readiness.
Google owns WIP after probe completion at TSMC only, not before; ownership transfers at goods receipt, subject to Google confirmation.
All Phase 1 and Phase 2 manufacturing steps occur within Taiwan; no international mid-stream flows until Phase 3.
Inventory POs are issued to TSMC and UMTC for wafer and substrate procurement; subcontracting POs are issued to OSATs for all transformation steps.
Silicon Data Hub is the system of record for unit-level test data and yield inputs into Kinaxis.
Manufacturing strategy is Make-to-Stock through die bank and Make-to-Order from die bank to finished goods.
Lot genealogy and yield capture will reside in E2Open and the Silicon Data Hub, not SAP.
UMTC substrate has an 18-week lead time and a substrate PO may need to be cut before Kinaxis is live.
Kinaxis workbooks shall be recreated on a new instance with existing references.
Yield and MLS functionalities shall be a new configuration.
Subcontracting PO model: Google issues components to OSAT, OSAT transforms, Google receives finished part.
Schedule agreements for high-volume/rolling TSMC wafer orders are used instead of individual POs.
B-parts and C-parts are tracked separately.
EDI is used for existing partners; B2B/file-based or manual methods for others.
Google-owned tooling must be capitalized with depreciation tracked.
All Phase 1/2 manufacturing moves are within Taiwan and managed via intra-Taiwan flows.
Quanta acts as exporter of record for finished goods shipped from Taiwan to Google USA.
Google becomes importer of record for finished goods entering the USA under COT.
Kinaxis currently operates at L6/SoC level only and COT extends planning to wafer level.
GPlan is the primary middleware integrating PLM, SAP, and Kinaxis.
Integration between PLM to S/4HANA and Kinaxis to S/4HANA will be done through existing GPLAN/SAL API framework and Google internal team will configure.
Preferred approach is to retain Google's existing integration framework used for machines planning.
Existing integration will be leveraged and only incremental delta interfaces are in scope, subject to discovery analysis.
